name: deathspore thallid
mana cost: {1}{B}
types: creature zombie fungus
power toughness: 1/1
activated[1]: remove three spore counters from CARDNAME: create a 1/1 green saproling creature token.
activated[2]: sacrifice a saproling: target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
triggered: at the beginning of your upkeep, put a spore counter on CARDNAME.
